status: written after reading the complete v6.5 run and before any of the following existed: the optical flow of any Argoverse 2 pair, the LiDAR road plane of any pair, any Bonn pair with a re-estimated pose. The Argoverse 2 images, LiDAR and labels were already used in v6.5 (exact correspondences only), so H14 is registered on data that had been seen but on quantities that had not been computed. Every other item is exploratory or a correction.

registered_hypotheses.H14 (the twin test survives optical flow: Argoverse 2, all logs, moving vehicles in the parallel regime (regime from the labelled correspondences, as in v6.5) whose flow correspondences have a static solution (at most half of their LiDAR pixels triangulate behind the camera). Both tests from the same forward-backward checked flow at the vehicle's LiDAR pixels: epipolar test, median |eps| above its 95th percentile over parked vehicles; twin test, the 10th percentile of the heights of the static reconstruction above the road plane fitted by RANSAC to the LiDAR returns of the image (no labelled box) outside its 2.5-97.5% range over parked vehicles. Prediction: det_twin - det_epipolar > 0, paired cluster-bootstrap 95% CI > 0 (cluster = vehicle track). Rationale: with exact correspondences the twin test flagged parallel movers the epipolar test cannot see; a deployed system has flow, not labels, and noise in the flow could erase the twin's displacement for slow vehicles.
registered_hypotheses.rules: NOT TESTABLE below 20 vehicles or 10 tracks, or below 20 parked vehicles with flow (no thresholds); verdicts as for H5-H13. No model output enters H14.

corrections.Bonn ground truth (D62): in v6.5 the motion-capture poses (calibration and synchronisation error) made static pixels miss their rigid flow by about 2 px, so large parts of the static scene were taken for moving objects. v6.6 re-estimates the relative pose of every pair from its static correspondences (RANSAC PnP, pairs whose fit fails are left out), does not test pixels hidden in the second image, keeps a moving region only if the static prediction fails photometrically on it and if it is not larger than 20% of the image, and takes the floor as the lowest well-supported horizontal level. If the median pair still flags more than 15% of its static scene, Bonn is not interpreted. Bonn stays exploratory.

exploratory_analyses.contact gates parallax (6.10): the rise of beta_s from the x0.5 to the x3 baseline for floating minus grounded movers (the H12-interaction row that v6.5 already reported), now listed as claim C33; chosen after the v6.5 results, so descriptive.
exploratory_analyses.how much of the hump the cue model expla: the fall of the median rho from its observed peak to the bin of largest x, observed and as each fit has it.

why: Two weaknesses of v6.5 were in the measurements, not in the models: the twin test used labelled correspondences, which no deployed system has, and the Bonn objects were partly static scenery. H14 asks whether the twin test still works with the correspondences a pipeline would have; the Bonn correction asks whether the real floating objects say anything once the ground truth is right.
